meta.title: Innogenio — AI Guide
meta.description: Your AI guide, in four questions.

hero.headline: Your AI guide, in four questions.
hero.body: Answer four quick questions and let our advisor generate a personalized recommendation tailored to your industry and business objectives.

industry.title: Which industry are you in?
industry.body: Pick the sector that best describes your business.

process.title: Which process would you improve first?
process.body: Select up to two areas where automation would move the needle.

objective.title: What outcome matters most?
objective.body: Choose up to three business goals.

challenge.title: What's holding you back today?
challenge.body: Choose up to three operational challenges.

Customer support.name: Conversational AI & Intelligent Support
Customer support.blurb: an AI assistant that resolves routine queries instantly and routes the rest with full context

Document & data processing.name: Intelligent Document Processing
Document & data processing.blurb: an AI pipeline that extracts, validates, and files documents without manual data entry

Analytics & reporting.name: AI Analytics & Decision Intelligence
Analytics & reporting.blurb: a decision layer that turns scattered data into forecasts and clear next-best-actions

Quality control.name: Computer-Vision Quality Control
Quality control.blurb: a vision system that inspects output in real time and flags defects before they ship

Demand forecasting.name: Predictive Forecasting Engine
Demand forecasting.blurb: a forecasting model that anticipates demand and optimizes stock and capacity

Fraud & risk detection.name: AI Risk & Anomaly Detection
Fraud & risk detection.blurb: a monitoring model that catches anomalies and fraud patterns as they emerge

Personalization.name: AI Personalization & Recommendations
Personalization.blurb: a recommendation engine that tailors every experience to each user in real time

Back-office automation.name: Intelligent Process Automation
Back-office automation.blurb: AI-driven automation that removes repetitive back-office work end-to-end

Predictive maintenance.name: Predictive Maintenance System
Predictive maintenance.blurb: a model that predicts equipment failure before it causes costly downtime

default.blurb: a tailored AI system built around your specific processes and goals

impact.headline: A clear starting point — in minutes, not meetings.
impact.body: The advisor turns your answers into a concrete, industry-aware plan you can act on right away.
